What's the darknet, what's it have different from the Deep Web and why should I use it?

I'm surprised this haven't been answered, so I'll give it a shot.

Deep webs are mostly webs that aren't indexed by Google or any search engine and it's partially relevant to Darknet. Darknet is a network, not a web, that aren't easily visible to the Internet and it is usually an anonymous network that avoid some of the common problems like targetted advertising, censorship, survillance by either government or family and so forth. It is important to note that when you're in the Darknet, just remember that Freedom of Speech is two sides of a coin.

There is another part next to Darknet (not the opposite per se) which is the Meshnet which can forgo some or all anonymity for connectivity benefits (routing to whoever have the best bandwidth) and so forth, that would allow people on the network to have access to resources provided on that network while Internet does not in certain cases like severe bandwidth cap, prolonged internet blackout that are either local or regional, constant false-DMCA takedowns and so forth. It also sometime allow people who peered with others to regulate the meshnet within their own hub thus limiting the offending contents through the practice of depeering the offender. There are however some types of Meshnet that are oriented on anonymity which forgo some of the connectivities benefit.

I hope this clarify a bit.

It's a gray area, you can argue that you have the right to privacy which is one of the reason why Darknet was made.
